usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the full configuration of a specific external metrics server (e.g. InfluxDB or Graphite) registered in the cluster by its config ID. Requires Sys.Audit on the root path, so API tokens used for read-only monitoring dashboards are sufficient. The `id` must match a pve-configid value visible in the list returned by the sibling list operation; supplying an unknown id results in a 500-level error.

examples.summary: Read the configuration for an InfluxDB metrics server named 'influx-prod'

tips: The id must conform to pve-configid format: lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only, no spaces.
Response includes connection details (host, port, protocol) and status flags; use it to verify before making write changes via the update endpoint.
API tokens with only Sys.Audit can call this — no need for Sys.Modify for a read.
